summary.text: Yolanda Young is a Democratic member of the Missouri House of Representatives who has represented District 22 since January 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her as the only candidate in the general election for the seat.

paragraphs.text: Young was assigned to the House Budget and Ethics committees and the Rural Economic Development committee for 2025-2026.
In 2023-2024 she served on the Agriculture Policy, House Economic Development and Workforce Development committees.
